sources.label: Verified mF-ONE implementation and inherited transfer blacklist checks

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095810, mF-ONE proxy 0x238a700ed6165261cf8b2e544ba797bc11e466ba used implementation 0x32fb951ce9be3cd9a0a406ea86647a3c7d6406e2 and shared MidasAccessControl 0x0312a9d1ff2372ddedcbb21e4b6389afc919ac4b. The verified inherited transfer path calls _onlyNotBlacklisted(from) and _onlyNotBlacklisted(to); the access-control contract lets role administrators grant or revoke BLACKLISTED_ROLE. This confirms the existing Yes verdict with deployment-bound code and state.
